commands.ac4:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-4: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f _docs/openapi.yaml ] || { echo "FAIL AC-4: not run from the TableQueue repo root (_docs/openapi.yaml missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -x backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ] || { echo "FAIL AC-4: not measured - backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe is missing (create the suite venv: cd backend && uv sync)"; exit 1; }
F=backend/tests/test_e2e_contract.py
[ -f "$F" ] || { echo "FAIL AC-4: the conformance sweep test file backend/tests/test_e2e_contract.py is missing - if it moved, re-groom this AC"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p backend/.scratch
scratch="backend/.scratch/_t16ac4_$$.db"; srel="${scratch#backend/}"; rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch.out"
( cd backend && env DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///$srel" JWT_SECRET="t16ac4-secret-0123456789-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" STAFF_PIN=0000 ENV=development TZ=UTC .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_e2e_contract.py -q > "${srel}.out" 2>&1 )
prc=$?
backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe - "$F" <<'PY'
import re, sys
F = sys.argv[1]
t = open(F, encoding='utf-8').read()
problems = []
for frag in ('public/board', 'staff/login', 'staff/pin/change'):
    if frag not in t:
        problems.append('no reference to the legacy path fragment %r' % frag)
if '422' not in t or 'VALIDATION_ERROR' not in t:
    problems.append('no 422 VALIDATION_ERROR envelope coverage')
if '/seat' not in t:
    problems.append('no /seat operation coverage')
cands = []
try:
    import yaml
    contract = yaml.safe_load(open('_docs/openapi.yaml', encoding='utf-8').read())
    cands = [p for p in (contract.get('paths') or {}) if 'close' in p.lower()]
except Exception:
    pass
if not re.search(r'(?i)close.{0,4}day', t) and not any(p in t for p in cands):
    problems.append('no close-day surface coverage')
if problems:
    print('FAIL AC-4: the sweep test does not cover the new contract surface - ' + '; '.join(problems))
    raise SystemExit(1)
PY
s=$?
if [ $s -ne 0 ]; then
  rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch.out"; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  exit 1
fi
if [ $prc -ne 0 ] || ! grep -q " passed" "$scratch.out"; then
  tail -n 5 "$scratch.out"
  echo "FAIL AC-4: the sweep test run answered rc=$prc - last lines above"
  rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch.out"; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-4: the sweep test references all three legacy path fragments, the 422 VALIDATION_ERROR envelope with /seat, the Close-Day surface, and still passes ($F: $(tail -n 1 "$scratch.out" | grep -o '[0-9]* passed[^,]*' | head -1))"
rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch.out"; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
exit 0
